title: Scheduling Order and Notice of Hearing (Docket No. 26-035-05)
text:
- BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION OF UTAH - 

Application of Rocky Mountain Power for 
Approval of a Large-Load Service 
Contract Between PacifiCorp and a 
Large-Load Customer 

DOCKET NO. 26-035-05 

SCHEDULING ORDER AND NOTICE OF 
HEARING 

ISSUED: February 13, 2026 

On February 10, 2026, Rocky Mountain Power (RMP) filed its Application in the 
above-referenced docket. In the Application, RMP states that it, in coordination with 
the Division of Public Utilities (DPU) and the Office of Consumer Services (OCS), 
developed the following proposed procedural schedule, which the PSC approves and 
adopts based on RMP’s assertion it is authorized to represent DPU and OCS support 
the proposed schedule. 
SCHEDULE 
ITEM 
DEADLINE/DATE/TIME/LOCATION 
Non-Applicant Direct Testimony 
Tuesday, March 3, 2026 
Rebuttal Testimony, All Parties 
Tuesday, March 10, 2026 
Hearing 
Tuesday, March 17, 2026, beginning at 
9:00 a.m., Fourth Floor Hearing Room 
403, Heber M. Wells Building, Salt 
Lake City, Utah 

DISCOVERY 

Discovery turn-around times are five calendar days throughout. Parties shall 
serve discovery requests and responses on applicable parties by electronic mail. In 
the event a document produced in response to a discovery request cannot reasonably 
DOCKET NO. 26-035-05 

- 2 - 

be transmitted by electronic mail, the party disclosing the document shall provide an 
electronic copy of the document on CD (or, if an electronic copy is not available, a 
paper copy). 
NOTICE OF HEARING 

The PSC will conduct a hearing on Tuesday, March 17, 2026, beginning at 9:00 
a.m., Fourth Floor Hearing Room 403, Heber M. Wells Building, 160 East 300 South, 
Salt Lake City, Utah. All parties must have their witnesses in attendance and prepared 
to testify. Any person desiring to attend this event must show government-issued 
photo identification to be admitted past the building security station. 
Individuals wishing to participate in the hearing remotely should contact the 
PSC at least two days in advance by calling (801) 530-6716 or (toll-free) 1-866-PSC-
UTAH (1-866-772-8824) to receive connection information and instructions. 

Individuals needing accommodations during the hearing should notify the PSC 
at 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111, (801) 530-6716, at least three 
working days prior to the hearing. 
DATED at Salt Lake City, Utah, February 13, 2026.
